comment: Public-output leak rules for the video-utils static landing. Modelled on the xoxd.ai rule file
scripts/lib/leak-scan-rules.json at origin/main cc570c3 (commit date 2026-10-05). Read by
scripts/leak-scan.mjs and by the Python port in the lane test module, which must agree.
Patterns are RegExp source strings valid in both JavaScript (u flag) and Python; flags are applied
per rule and the scanner adds g.
Ported with the same intent (15): the six secret rules, the cluster credential rule, the private
host name, private address, cache endpoint, loopback, source map, developer path, tracker and dash
rules. Not ported: the upstream rule that enumerates private individuals (copying it would itself
be a leak) and the upstream timed-promise rule (superseded by the banned phrase list in the lane
contract). No upstream allowlist entry is copied.
Added for video-utils (9): real-take-filename, media-file-reference, content-hash-64,
run-identifier, artifact-path-reference, nix-store-path, analytics-or-beacon,
form-or-upload-surface, private-estate-hostname.
Self-safety: this file is scanned like any other source file and gets no exemption. Literals that
a rule would match are written with a one-character class, and the two rules whose own id contains
their trigger word carry a narrow negative lookahead for that id suffix only.
Per-rule surface fields. skipVendorRuntimeChunks: the build scan skips the rule for files under
_app/immutable/chunks/ (framework runtime, the upstream behaviour for the two content-authorship
rules). sourceScope src: in the source scan the rule applies to files under src/ only.
vendorCarrier: the rule is one of the nine applied to the unmodified third-party carriers under
vendor/ (secrets, host paths, real-take names).
Framework deviations measured on the Phase 2 build (2026-10-07). None changes what authored
content may contain.
1. form-or-upload-surface: the file-input alternative carries a lookbehind that refuses a
preceding bracket or word character. Cause: the Skeleton stylesheet in
_app/immutable/assets/0.*.css ships six attribute selectors for a file selector button
(bracket, the attribute name, equals, the value). An HTML attribute is preceded by white space,
so an authored file input still fires.
2. analytics-or-beacon: the advertising host alternative requires its .net suffix. Cause: the
layout chunk _app/immutable/nodes/0.*.js carries a component library event-name map whose
double-click handler key matched the bare word case-insensitively.
3. allowedPublicForgeUrls: exact URL exceptions to the forge-host alternative of
internal-tracker-reference, the upstream mechanism with none of its entries. Cause: the
published font licence text names its two upstream font projects. Any other forge path,
query string or fragment remains a finding.

allowedHostsComment: Starts empty for authored hosts. Each entry below was added only because the Phase 2 build or an
authored static file actually contains it. No authored page links to any of them.
www.w3.org: the SVG and XHTML namespace identifiers in every built page (icon markup from the
chrome), in static/favicon.svg and in the Svelte runtime chunk. Identifiers, never fetched.
svelte.dev: documentation links inside the Svelte runtime's own error messages in
_app/immutable/chunks/. Framework code, not rendered as page text.
scripts.sil.org: the SIL Open Font License address inside fonts/OFL.txt, the licence text that
must accompany the self-hosted font files.
The forge host is deliberately NOT on this list: fonts/OFL.txt credits the two upstream font
projects by URL, and only the two exact URLs in allowedPublicForgeUrls pass, both for
internal-tracker-reference and for the outbound host check.
